models.name: BF16
models.summary: Not a very impressive pelican, but it competes with the best of this size class.

models.name: FP8
models.summary: Similar quality to the BF16 run, unimpressive. Competitive for the size range, which is a low bar. Kinda looks like a sick drumset.

models.name: Q8_0
models.summary: Awful. It literally made the body of a bird into a wheeled vehicle.

models.name: Q4_K_M
models.summary: As bad as the rest. At least there are wheels, but that's the extent of the praise.
